payload.friendly_name: Docsite publication rules, llms.txt and render parity
payload.purpose_context: The doc-kitty docsite must publish exactly the intended pages before cutover: plans working notes as drafts, retired hosted and sync pages archived, with frontmatter and link gates on the published set; an llms.txt that carries the version stance; and the SEO and alert rendering DocFX gives today, proven on the built site. DocFX keeps deploying.
payload.purpose_tldr: Publish only what should be public on the doc-kitty site, generate llms.txt with the version stance, and match DocFX's rendering (#6932, #6934, #6935)
